props.gloss_en: Abaye: [prohibition by] its flavour and not its substance, in general, is Torah law
(entertained) taamo velo mamasho is rabbinic
(within the hypothesis) why do we not learn from meat in milk? because it is a novelty
if it is a novelty, then even where there is no imparting of flavour [it should be forbidden] too
Rava: the Torah forbade [meat in milk] in the manner of cooking
Rav: once it imparted flavour to the piece, the piece itself becomes nevela
and it forbids all the pieces, every one
because they are its type
Mar Zutra: now, in accordance with whom did Rav say his teaching? R' Yehuda
R' Yehuda, who said: a type in its own type is not nullified
Rava: R' Yehuda holds: whatever is a type, its type and something else -- set aside its type as though it is not
and what is not its type is greater than it and nullifies it
Ravina: if it fell into thin gravy -- so indeed; here we are dealing with where it fell into thick gravy
[an item that] can be wrung out -- is permitted
[an item that] can be wrung out -- is forbidden
an olive-bulk of meat that fell into a pot of milk -- Rav: the meat is forbidden and the milk permitted
(stam, first answer) there it is different, for the verse says 'you shall not cook a kid in its mother's milk' -- the Torah forbade the kid, and not the milk
half an olive-bulk of meat and half an olive-bulk of milk that he cooked together -- Rav: he is flogged for eating it
and he is not flogged for cooking it
(stam, surviving answer) rather, Rav holds the milk too is forbidden, and here we deal with where it fell into a boiling pot: it absorbs, it does not expel
actually they do not combine, and [the eating is] where it comes from a large pot
Levi: he is flogged for cooking it too
Levi's baraita: just as he is flogged for eating it, so he is flogged for cooking it; and of what cooking did they say it? of cooking such that others eat it on account of its cooking
stam: and efshar lesochato itself is [a dispute of] tannaim
R' Yehuda: a drop of milk that fell on the piece -- once it imparted flavour to the piece, the piece itself becomes nevela and forbids all the pieces, because they are its type
Chachamim: [it does not forbid] until it imparts flavour to the gravy, the spices and the pieces
Rebbi: R' Yehuda's words appear [correct] where he did not stir and did not cover
and Chachamim's words where he stirred and covered
reading: he did not stir at all and did not cover at all
reading: he did not stir at first but at the end, and did not cover at first but at the end
stam: by implication R' Yehuda holds that where he stirred from start to end and covered from start to end -- forbidden
reading: he stirred at the end and not at first, and covered at the end and not at first
rather: he stirred from start to end and covered from start to end
stam: by implication the Rabbis hold that where he stirred at the end and not at first, covered at the end and not at first -- permitted

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה רבא: דרך בישול אסרה תורה -- the flavour-measure of meat in milk follows from the manner of cooking, so it does not show that meat in milk is no novelty

objections.gloss_en: וסבר רב אפשר לסוחטו אסור? והאיתמר: כזית בשר שנפל לתוך יורה של חלב, אמר רב: בשר אסור וחלב מותר -- חלב אמאי מותר? חלב נבלה הוא! (the first answer, gedi velo chalav at 108b.2, was refuted and abandoned -- see p_gedi_velo_chalav)

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא לעולם קסבר רב חלב נמי אסור, והכא במאי עסקינן -- כגון שנפל לתוך יורה רותחת, דמבלע בלע מפלט לא פליט (= p_yora_rotachat)

objections.gloss_en: וסבר רב גדי אסרה תורה ולא חלב? והא איתמר: חצי זית בשר וחצי זית חלב... לוקה על אכילתו -- if the kid only, why is he flogged for eating? it is half a measure!
סוף סוף כי נייח הדר פליט! -- in the end, when it settles, it expels

answered_by.gloss_en: כשקדם וסילקו -- where he removed it first

objections.gloss_en: ואלא לא ניער בתחלה אלא בסוף... אמאי? הא בלע והא פלט! -- why should R' Yehuda's forbidding be correct there?

answered_by.gloss_en: קסבר אפשר לסוחטו אסור -- [Rebbi] holds an item that can be wrung out is forbidden (attribution to rebbi of p_els_asur)

objections.gloss_en: אמאי? הא לא בלע כלל! -- if he stirred from start to end, the piece absorbed nothing

answered_by.gloss_en: אימא: לא ניער יפה יפה, ולא כסה יפה יפה -- say: he did not stir thoroughly and did not cover thoroughly

objections.gloss_en: ממאי דבאפשר לסוחטו פליגי? דלמא אפשר לסוחטו דברי הכל אסור, והכא במין במינו קא מיפלגי -- R' Yehuda: a type in its type is not nullified; the Rabbis: it is nullified

answered_by.gloss_en: האי מאי? if the Rabbis here agree with R' Yehuda on a type in its type and they dispute efshar lesochato, that is why Rebbi said 'R' Yehuda's words appear in this, Chachamim's in that'; but if all agree efshar lesochato is forbidden and they dispute a type in its type, he should have said 'R' Yehuda's words appear and do not appear' (109a.8). Steinsaltz gives this reply to Ravina; the text names no speaker.
